ache.title: A theater mode where empty seats feel like failure
ache.note: Imaginarium Theater gets a starter guide here. Endgame modes like this tend to reward owning lots of characters, so every gap in your roster starts to look like a missed reward. That’s pressure dressed up as a stage show. You can enjoy the acts you can clear and leave the rest of the seats empty.
watch: endgame that rewards a wide roster
gaps that feel like missed rewards
ache.tip: Clear what your current team can and call it done. Empty seats aren’t a failure.
